sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 44 (check 43) and Internal Quality Checks row 44 ('Gate/constraint failures hard-zero the quality terms, and passing only the cheap gates earns little.')
evidence: tests/scoring.toml [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (gates absent from weights, so no reward mass); [floors] functional = 0.05 - byte-identical to the frozen template scoring.toml, test.sh and tools/score.py (diff empty). Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with binary criteria, so a gate scores 0 or 1. score.py:40-48 computes gates_passed = all(scores[k] > 0.0), sets every weighted dimension to 0.0 unless gates passed and scored ran, sets floors_passed only if functional > 0.05, and reward = weighted only when gates_passed and floors_passed; it returns exit 1 on gate failure (line 83). test.sh:212 deletes any stale scored dir before the gates suite, and test.sh:213-222 runs gates, then score.py; exit 1 -> exit 0 without running the scored suite (detailed zero record kept), other errors -> write_zero_reward; a gates-suite timeout/failure also exits with the pre-written zero. Scored suite runs only at line 224. Executed the frozen score.py (python -I, scratch copy) on synthetic suite outputs: constraints=0 with a perfect scored reward.json present -> reward 0.0, all scored dims forced 0, exit 1; render=0 -> reward 0.0, exit 1; gates pass with functional 0.0339 (2.0/59 weight, e.g. two 1.0 criteria) and polish=visual=1 -> weighted 0.4203 but reward 0.0, floors_passed 0; functional exactly 0.05 -> reward 0.0 (strict >); functional 3.0/59=0.0508 -> reward 0.4305; all 1 -> 1.0. Functional weights sum 59.0 over 43 criteria (min weight 1.0), so the floor requires at least 3.0 weight units of genuinely passing functional behaviour; an app that does not work (passes <=2 cheap functional criteria) cannot farm polish/visual. Reaching the scored suite at all also requires passing the constraints gate (own non-form-field editor surface plus a server-shared saved snippet readback after storage clear and reload), so a static shell is excluded before shaping. Each scored prompt also restates the global browser gate zeroing that dimension. Residual (not a row-43 defect, template-controlled): an app clearing the floor with ~3/59 functional weight and perfect polish/visual could reach ~0.43; this ceiling and the 0.05 floor value are frozen template policy and belong to ranking/weight rows 39/42/44, which the workbook internal note ('passing only the cheap gates earns little') is satisfied by since gates alone earn 0. Runtime: no configured-judge run exists for v16 bytes; v15 hosted nop (no_op=1) only exercises the missing-server.js path, not the gate-fail branch. The row's mechanism is deterministic and was exercised directly via the frozen score.py; whether judges actually fail a dead app at the gate is the subject of rows 29/39, not this one.
